protocol.training: cold online, no held-out generalization claim
protocol.timing: sequential; model, marking, graph, learning, verification included; module load excluded

ablation.description: Same cluster rollout with learned returns ignored in ordering; table update costs retained.

conclusion: Verified windows out of 15: free-range 6, GCTS 6, RL clusters 6, GCTS + RL 7. Cluster lanes win some cases and lose others. Ignoring learned returns gave the same 6 / 15 completions in the RL ablation, so these results do not isolate a benefit from learning. Hat, turtle and tuning-fork probes remained unknown; buckled ring and twisted H have small periodic and isohedral point certificates. Three seeds are not a statistical superiority claim.
